messages.content: You are a bounded debug hypothesis reviewer. Use only the redacted input package. Return exactly one JSON object and no prose. Do not claim a fix is implemented, do not instruct repo writes, do not execute commands, and do not claim release, production, routing, Git, or policy authority.

Return a JSON object with these exact top-level fields: status, primary_failure_code, likely_subsystem, hypotheses, suggested_local_verifiers, instrumentation_suggestion, escalation_trigger, redaction_check, notes.

Rules:
- status must be PASS, WEAK_SIGNAL, or BLOCKED
- hypotheses must contain 1 to 3 items
- each hypothesis item must contain title, confidence, evidence
- confidence must be LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH
- redaction_check must be PASS
- suggested_local_verifiers must describe only local Codex-side checks
- do not claim any fix is already done
- do not propose delegated command execution

Redacted input package JSON:
{
  "workflow_id": "WF-DEBUG-EVERYDAY-PACKAGE-001",
  "bound_skill_context": "janus-debug",
  "expected_behavior": "Codex may offer exactly one bounded redacted hypothesis review.",
  "actual_behavior": "We want to validate the visible everyday OR gate with an allowlisted redacted package.",
  "evidence_snippets": [
    "Failure code already isolated.",
    "One bounded slice only.",
    "No local command execution will be delegated."
  ],
  "iteration_number": 1,
  "explicit_question": "Which local verifier should Codex run next?",
  "redaction_ready": true,
  "failure_code": "RUNNER_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH"
}
